turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: The matter is of the utmost delicacy, and I implore you, gentlemen, to exercise the utmost discretion.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Count Von Kramm, please proceed with your explanation.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I have reason to believe that a certain lady, Irene Adler, has obtained certain documents that could compromise the House of Ormstein.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I see, Count. These documents, do they have any particular significance?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: They contain information that, if revealed, could lead to a scandal that would ruin the reputation of the House of Ormstein.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: And you suspect that this lady, Irene Adler, has obtained these documents?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I have reason to believe so, sir. She is a clever and cunning woman.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: And you've tried to retrieve the documents from her?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Unfortunately, Count Von Kramm, I was unsuccessful in my attempts to retrieve them.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: You've employed me to retrieve these documents for you?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I have, sir. I was led to believe that you were the most capable man for the task.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: And what makes you think that these documents are still in the possession of this lady, Irene Adler?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I have reason to believe that she is hiding them in her apartment.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: And you want me to retrieve them from her?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Yes, sir. I beg of you, please, for the sake of the House of Ormstein.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: And what's the significance of the House of Ormstein to you, Count?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am the King of Bohemia, and the House of Ormstein is my family.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I see. And what's the nature of your relationship with this lady, Irene Adler?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: She is a woman of great intelligence and cunning, and I...I was enamored with her.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I think we understand the situation now, Count.
